topic: Sources and Uses of Sound Energy
key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work
The Sun is Earth's principal energy source
Sound energy is produced when matter vibrates
Sound travels through solids, liquids, and gases
Sound travels faster through solids than through gases
Ears catch sound waves and send signals to the brain
Common sound sources include people, animals, nature, household objects, and electronics
Sound energy is used for communication and safety
Very loud sound can harm hearing
